mapper.sql: select f.id, f.project_id, f.file_id, f.original_name, f.file_name, f.file_ext, f.mime_type, f.file_size, f.storage_path, f.file_category, f.file_hash, f.ai_parse_status, f.ai_parse_text, f.ai_parse_error, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, f.del_flag from cost_project_file f
mapper.select: select f.id, f.project_id, f.file_id, f.original_name, f.file_name, f.file_ext, f.mime_type, f.file_size, f.file_category, f.file_hash, f.ai_parse_status, f.ai_parse_error, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, f.del_flag from cost_project_file f where f.project_id = #{projectId} and f.del_flag = '0' order by f.create_time desc, f.id desc
select count(1) from cost_project_file where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into cost_project_file ( project_id, file_id, original_name, file_name, file_ext, mime_type, file_size, storage_path, file_category, file_hash, ai_parse_status, ai_parse_text, ai_parse_error, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag ) values ( #{projectId}, #{fileId}, #{originalName}, #{fileName}, #{fileExt}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{storagePath}, #{fileCategory}, #{fileHash}, #{aiParseStatus}, #{aiParseText}, #{aiParseError}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.update: update cost_project_file set file_category = #{fileCategory}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update cost_project_file set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
